text:
PORT ANSGAR, 14 March 2031 (Meridian Brief) — Kestrelline Rail will build its new maintenance depot in Port Ansgar, the company announced Friday, according to people familiar with the matter.

Maren Tolliver, Chief Infrastructure Officer of Kestrelline Rail, confirmed the Port Ansgar location when the site was formally unveiled.

The depot is budgeted at 412 million credits and will employ 1,150 staff once operational, those people said.

The decision is set out in the Kestrelline Rail Fleet Maintenance Expansion Plan, released at the company's spring investor briefing.

People familiar with the matter described the Port Ansgar site as central to the operator's plan to expand fleet servicing capacity.

Kestrelline Rail did not immediately provide further detail on construction timing.

Meridian Brief will update this item as further information becomes available.
